# Security Checklist: Plugin Settings on Plugin Info

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of secret handling and descriptor bounds
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an
item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is every place a setting value could be copied (metadata, logs, RPC errors) named in
  the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Are bounds specified for list length, key, environment name, description, default, and
  enum values? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec state what a host must not do with a secret, and that the flag is advisory
  next to the host's own credential rules? [Completeness, Spec §US1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is "empty default means no default" stated for every type, including string, so an
  empty-string default is not an unspecified case? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the integer, boolean, URL, and duration default grammars specific enough that two
  readers would accept the same strings? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the client-facing failure text distinguished from the operator-facing rule text, so a
  secret default has one place it must not appear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Does "settings are not copied into metadata" agree between the functional requirements,
  the edge cases, and the manifest decision? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK008 Is a required setting with a default given one meaning, with no second rule that the SDK
  must reject that combination? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements present for an empty list, a malformed list at startup, and a malformed
  list returned by a plugin's own plugin-info method? [Coverage, Spec §US2, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK010 Is a duplicate environment name covered as its own case, separate from a duplicate key?
  [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK011 Is the empty-list cost specified as allocating nothing, and is a non-empty valid list
  left as a separate cost? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the spec say the SDK does not scan metadata for secrets, so that exclusion is
  intentional rather than missing? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK013 Is host injection, including where a secret value is stored after the form, documented
  as out of scope and owned by core? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the choice to leave the manifest `configuration` object in place recorded as a
  decision rather than an open question? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]

## Notes

- Focus: secret handling and descriptor-contract completeness. Depth: standard. Audience: PR reviewer.
- Items stay unchecked. `/speckit-implement` reads them and does not mark them.
- `checklists/requirements.md` is the specify-phase spec-quality list and is separate.
